newsitem.title: USA: Company Doctor to buyback up to 150,000 shr.
newsitem.headline: Company Doctor to buyback up to 150,000 shr.

text.p: The Company Doctor said Wednesday it approved a stock repurchase plan under which the company may repurchase, in open market transactions, up to 150,000 shares of common stock.

The purchases will be made from time to time in open market transactions at the then-prevailing market price, although the company has no commitment or obligation to purchase all or any portion of the shares, a statement from The Company Doctor said.
The Company Doctor said it has about 4,972,693 shares of common stock issued and outstanding.
